messages:
Priya: Quick triage 1: Customer Zenith wants to move their private pilot up by 9 days. Must have customer-managed KMS (HSM) and p95 < 320ms. Need owners and a fallback plan by EOD.
Sam: What are their QPS and expected token lengths? Those determine prewarm and slot needs.
Priya: Zenith expects bursts to 110 QPS, avg 40. Typical request ~150 tokens, occasional 600-token long tails. Model preference: 13B; will accept 7B if needed.
Nadia: Security: HSM onboarding (attestation, key policies, audit-forwarding) is the blocker. Realistic ETA for full HSM path: 8 business days unless we expedite approvals.
Lee: Infra: To meet 110 QPS with 13B we need ~X dedicated slots (I'll quantify in my follow-up), plus VPC peering and flow logs. Hosted-KMS fallback pool can be spun up in ~3 business days.
Sam: Runtime: For p95 < 320ms, 7B with continuous batching + KV cache looks safe. 13B needs stricter prewarm and pinned nodes. Suggest we prepare a routing fallback.
Nadia: If we propose hosted-KMS fallback, we must provide a clear customer risk statement and commit to a cutover runbook for later HSM swap. I can draft that.
Priya: Proposed immediate options: A) Hold for HSM (delay launch); B) Proceed with hosted-KMS fallback + 7B now, migrate to HSM+13B later; C) Proceed with hosted-KMS + 13B (larger reserved pool). Fastest = B.
Lee: I can estimate slot delta and earliest reserve date by EOD if we lock model. I'll also prep a minimal prewarm policy for the hosted pool.
Sam: Routing pseudocode I'll prototype (48h): ```
route_policy:
  - if customer.hsm_ready == true:
      target: pool-hsm
  - else:
      target: pool-hosted-kms
canary_guard:
  duration: 5m
  metric: latency.p95
  threshold_ms: 350
  action: rollback
```
Nadia: I'll produce the HSM checklist + customer-facing risk blurb by EOD. Also list required approvals if Zenith insists on HSM earlier.
Priya: Action items: Nadia -> HSM checklist & risk blurb (EOD). Lee -> slot delta + earliest reserve (EOD). Sam -> routing prototype + canary guard perf (48h). Priya -> update SOW with fallback + acceptance criteria (today). infra-bot -> create ticket and schedule 30m sync.
infra-bot: Created ticket RDW-5120 "Zenith private-pilot HSM/KMS gating" and scheduled meeting 1811112400 (2pm PT). Assigned: Nadia, Lee, Sam, Priya.
Priya: Thanks all. If HSM slips, default = hosted-KMS + 7B and we notify Zenith with explicit rollback/cutover timeline. :thumbsup:
